digest.component_or_area: ChatGPT agent guidance and Rebar tracker integration
propositions: ChatGPT sessions in connector-limited Rebar environments lack documented guidance on recognizing capability constraints and safe fallback workflows
A new capability-check decision rule must define precisely when native ticket creation is impossible (tracker-worktree unavailable AND network/binary unavailable) to trigger the fallback

The fallback payload must conform to export.schema.json's required fields (schema_version, ticket_id, ticket_type, title, status) plus description and parent_id, with ticket_id as an agent-generated UUID4 that becomes source_id on import

rebar import is the only sanctioned exceptional ingest path and silently skips records missing ticket_id/ticket_type with no counter increment in dry-run mode; malformed records are detectable by comparing would_create + skipped against total record count
Guidance must prohibit hand-authoring tracker events, substituting GitHub Issues, and direct Contents API writes, and must require search-before-create and rebar validate/fsck post-import validation
A documentation test must verify discoverability, schema conformance, and absence of unsafe recommendations in both AGENTS.md and the new ChatGPT-specific guide
